paul_customer: hey team — starting ~09:10 UTC we're seeing a big tail on our request latencies to /v1/generate. p95 jumped from ~250ms to ~2.5s and p99 to ~12s for a subset of tenants. some requests return 502. example request id: req_abc123. can you triage?

maria_support: acknowledged. i'm looking at the tenant dashboard now. can you paste a curl/headers for the failing call or a sample trace id? also which region?

paul_customer: region=us-west-2. curl we used: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-tenant-id: acme-inc" -H "x-request-id: req_abc123" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
latency report from our client: p50 180ms, p95 2.3s, p99 12.2s, error rate ~0.8%. saw spike starting 09:08. attaching small trace: `trace://r-req_abc123`

maria_support: thx. escalating to eng runtime/oncall. @jon_eng_runtime @alex_oncall can you take a look? i'll keep Paul updated.

jon_eng_runtime: looking. quick checks: can you run on your end with `x-request-id` and share the response headers? i want to see `x-redwood-node` and `x-queue-time-ms`. also i'll check ingress and worker metrics.

maria_support: from our side grabbing logs for req_abc123 and nearby requests (last 20m). snippet: 
```
[09:09:42] admission_controller.go: enqueue_time_ms=4621 tenant=acme-inc
[09:09:42] worker_pool.go: queued=240 active=48 max_workers=48
[09:09:43] model_loader.go: model_init_ms=3200 model=large-llm-v2
[09:09:44] http_gateway.go: resp_code=502 upstream_error="worker timeout"
```

jon_eng_runtime: that log lines up — worker_pool hit max_workers and queued=240. looks like the workers are saturated and model init spikes (model_init_ms=3.2s) pushed requests into the admission queue. admission queue growth -> higher p95/p99.

jon_eng_runtime: immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) increase runtime.worker_pool.max from 48 -> 64 for this deployment, 2) enable tenant-level fallback to smaller model `redwood/smaller-llm-v1` for non-SLAs, 3) roll a quick restart of a subset of worker pods to clear stuck threads. i'll coordinate with @alex_oncall for the restart.

alex_oncall: ready to roll. i'll do a rolling restart with `kubectl rollout restart deployment/worker -n prod --selector=pool=high-cpu` in 2 mins and monitor. also can temporarily bump autoscaler minReplicas by +2.

nina_product: quick Q — did anything change to model config or rollout this morning that could cause more cold inits? product didn't schedule a user-facing deploy but there was a config tweak to weights at 08:58 UTC (A/B traffic split) — @jon_eng_runtime might be related.

maria_support: applied the tenant fallback for acme-inc and increased worker_pool. executing restart now. will post metrics after. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria_support: post-mitigation snapshot (09:18): p95 reduced to 2.1s, p99 down to 3.5s, error rate back to 0.1%. admission queue length dropped from 240 -> 12. looks like mitigation held. :thumbsup:

jon_eng_runtime: good. preliminary root cause hypothesis: the A/B traffic split change at 08:58 routed a larger fraction of requests to `large-llm-v2` that had a higher cold-start penalty due to a recent change in quantization/loading path. that caused intermittent model_init spikes and propagated into queueing. we'll revert the traffic tweak for the time being and open a rollback+postmortem.

paul_customer: thanks for the fast response. can you confirm whether this will affect billing or if any requests were double-charged? our finance team is asking.

maria_support: short answer: we don't double-bill on retries for server-side queueing. i'll confirm with billing and follow up in thread.

jon_eng_runtime: next actions: (1) revert A/B split to previous configuration (rolling change, target 10:30 UTC), (2) implement smoothing in admission controller so large bursts get rate-limited per-tenant instead of letting global queue blow up, (3) add metric alerts for model_init_ms > 1s sustained. i'll create INC and assign. ETA for config revert + smoothing rollout: ~2h.

srebot: Incident created: INC-2026-3370 assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P2. Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-3370

maria_support: I'll keep Paul updated until the revert is in and p99 stays stable for 30m. closing loop once we have postmortem and runbook updates.

paul_customer: appreciated — please DM if anything else is needed from our side.
